# Ports

Every port interface in `pianoanchor.core.ports`, from its KDoc.

## `AttemptRepositoryPort`

Driven port: the learner's completed attempts, kept across app restarts and keyed by [Attempt.id]. Contract: `pianoanchor.testing.AttemptRepositoryPortContractTest`.

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `suspend fun save(attempt: Attempt)` | Stores [attempt], with its events and played notes. Throws [IllegalArgumentException] when its id is already stored. Throws [StorageUnavailableException] when the store can't be read or written. |
| `suspend fun get(id: String): Attempt?` | The stored attempt with [id], or null if none is stored. Throws [StorageUnavailableException] when the store can't be read or written. |
| `fun recent(passageId: String, limit: Int): Flow<List<Attempt>>` | The attempts of [passageId], newest first by [Attempt.startedAt] (ties in any order), at most [limit] of them. Emits the current list on collection and again after every save. Throws [IllegalArgumentException] when [limit] is not positive. The flow fails with [StorageUnavailableException] when the store can't be read. |
| `suspend fun countStartedBefore(passageId: String, before: Instant): Int` | How many attempts of [passageId] started strictly before [before]; 0 for an unknown passage. Adapters that store [Attempt.startedAt] coarser compare at that precision. Throws [StorageUnavailableException] when the store can't be read or written. |
| `suspend fun cleanTempos(passageId: String): Set<Int>` | Tempos (BPM) of [passageId]'s timed attempts whose band is CLEAN, spot-loop attempts ([Attempt.spot]) excluded; empty when none. Throws [StorageUnavailableException] when the store can't be read or written. |
| `suspend fun hasCleanWaitRun(passageId: String): Boolean` | Whether [passageId] has a wait-mode attempt (no tempo) whose band is CLEAN, spot-loop attempts excluded. Throws [StorageUnavailableException] when the store can't be read or written. |
| `suspend fun lastPlayed(passageId: String): Instant?` | When [passageId] was last played: the latest [Attempt.startedAt] of its attempts, or null for a passage never played. Adapters that store [Attempt.startedAt] coarser answer at that precision. Throws [StorageUnavailableException] when the store can't be read or written. |
| `suspend fun practiceDays(from: LocalDate, zone: TimeZone): Set<LocalDate>` | The calendar days, in [zone], from [from] on (inclusive) on which at least one attempt of any passage started; empty when none. Throws [StorageUnavailableException] when the store can't be read or written. |

Contract test: `testing/src/commonMain/kotlin/pianoanchor/testing/AttemptRepositoryPortContractTest.kt`

## `CalibrationRepositoryPort`

Driven port: each piano's latency offset, kept across restarts and keyed by MidiDevice.id. Positive means the piano's notes arrive later than the click they answer. Throws [StorageUnavailableException] when the store can't be read or written (#55). Contract: `pianoanchor.testing.CalibrationRepositoryPortContractTest`.

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `suspend fun latencyOffsetNanos(deviceId: String): Long?` | The stored offset for [deviceId], or null if it was never calibrated. |
| `suspend fun setLatencyOffsetNanos(deviceId: String, offsetNanos: Long)` | Stores [offsetNanos] for [deviceId], replacing an earlier one. |

Contract test: `testing/src/commonMain/kotlin/pianoanchor/testing/CalibrationRepositoryPortContractTest.kt`

## `ClockPort`

Driven port: a monotonic time source in nanoseconds.

All engine timing (matching, grading, scheduling within a session) uses one clock domain. Adapters must never go backwards. Wall-clock time is not provided here. Contract: `pianoanchor.testing.ClockPortContractTest`.

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `fun nowNanos(): Long` | Current monotonic time in nanoseconds; only differences between readings are meaningful. |

Contract test: `testing/src/commonMain/kotlin/pianoanchor/testing/ClockPortContractTest.kt`

## `InstrumentRepositoryPort`

Driven port: the pianos the app has seen, kept across app restarts and keyed by [Instrument.deviceId]. Contract: `pianoanchor.testing.InstrumentRepositoryPortContractTest`.

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `suspend fun upsert(instrument: Instrument)` | Stores [instrument]. When its device id is already stored, replaces name and lastSeen and keeps the earlier of the stored and the given firstSeen. For a stable device id (`isStableDeviceId`) the identity is replaced only when the given one is non-null: a null identity keeps the stored one, so a lost Identity Reply doesn't erase it. For an unstable id (`sys:`, which may later name another piano) the given identity always replaces the stored one, so null clears it. Throws [StorageUnavailableException] when the store can't be read or written. |
| `suspend fun get(deviceId: String): Instrument?` | The stored instrument with [deviceId], or null if none is stored. Throws [StorageUnavailableException] when the store can't be read or written. |

Contract test: `testing/src/commonMain/kotlin/pianoanchor/testing/InstrumentRepositoryPortContractTest.kt`

## `LearnerRepositoryPort`

Driven port: the learner's review log (the source of truth) and the cached state per skill, which a replay of the log can always rebuild. Throws [StorageUnavailableException] when the store can't be read or written (#55). Contract: `pianoanchor.testing.LearnerRepositoryPortContractTest`.

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `suspend fun record(review: Review, state: SkillState)` | Appends [review] and replaces the cached [state] of its skill in one transaction. Throws [IllegalArgumentException] when the skill already has a review on that day or [SkillState.skillId] differs. |
| `suspend fun states(): Map<String, SkillState>` | Cached states of every skill seen, keyed by id. |
| `suspend fun reviews(skillId: String): List<Review>` | Reviews of [skillId] in day order. |
| `suspend fun replaceStates(states: Collection<SkillState>)` | Replaces every cached state (after a replay); the log is untouched. |

Contract test: `testing/src/commonMain/kotlin/pianoanchor/testing/LearnerRepositoryPortContractTest.kt`

## `MetronomePort`

Driven port: an audible beat. Times are in the [ClockPort] domain (monotonic nanoseconds). Contract: `pianoanchor.testing.MetronomePortContractTest`.

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `suspend fun start(firstBeatNanos: Long, beatIntervalNanos: Long, beatsPerBar: Int)` | Clicks at [firstBeatNanos] and every [beatIntervalNanos] after it until [stop], accenting every [beatsPerBar]th beat starting with the first. Replaces a running pattern. Beats already in the past are skipped, keeping the phase. Throws IllegalArgumentException when [beatIntervalNanos] <= 0 or [beatsPerBar] < 1. Audio is queued a little ahead, so a beat within a few tens of milliseconds of the call may be skipped or still follow the replaced pattern: start a pattern well ahead of its first beat (a count-in leaves room for that). |
| `suspend fun stop()` | Stops clicking; a no-op when idle. |

Contract test: `testing/src/commonMain/kotlin/pianoanchor/testing/MetronomePortContractTest.kt`

## `MidiDiscoveryPort`

Driven port: finding and connecting MIDI devices that are not listed until connected (e.g. Bluetooth LE). Contract: `pianoanchor.testing.MidiDiscoveryPortContractTest`.

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `fun scan(): Flow<List<MidiDevice>>` | Scans while collected: emits the devices found so far (starting with an empty list), de-duplicated by id, and completes after `Tunables.BLE_SCAN_TIMEOUT_MS`. Devices already listed when the scan starts are not included. Fails with [BluetoothUnavailableException] if scanning isn't possible. |
| `suspend fun connect(device: MidiDevice)` | Connects [device], which was found by a [scan] of this adapter, **or has a Bluetooth id this adapter can open directly** (`ble:<address>`, as an earlier run stored it); returns once it is listed in [MidiInputPort.inputDevices] and [MidiOutputPort.outputDevices] under the same id (within `Tunables.BLE_LISTED_TIMEOUT_MS` of opening). While the app runs, the adapter reopens it after a drop (backoff from `Tunables.BLE_RECONNECT_INITIAL_MS` to `BLE_RECONNECT_MAX_MS`, giving up after `BLE_RECONNECT_GIVE_UP_MS`); during a drop the device is not listed. Connecting a device that is already connected and listed does nothing. |
| `suspend fun disconnect(device: MidiDevice)` | Stops reconnecting [device] and closes it if open. No-op if unknown. |

Contract test: `testing/src/commonMain/kotlin/pianoanchor/testing/MidiDiscoveryPortContractTest.kt`

## `MidiInputPort`

Driven port: MIDI messages arriving from instruments. Contract: `pianoanchor.testing.MidiInputPortContractTest`.

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `val inputDevices: Flow<List<MidiDevice>>` | Input devices currently available. Emits the current list as soon as it is collected, then a new list after every change. Never completes. A Bluetooth device that drops stays listed for up to the adapter's drop grace (`Tunables.BLE_DROP_GRACE_MS`) while it is reopened. |
| `fun events(device: MidiDevice): Flow<MidiEvent>` | Opens [device] while collected and emits its messages in arrival order, each stamped in the `ClockPort` clock domain with non-decreasing timestamps. Messages that arrive while nobody collects are dropped. A dropped Bluetooth device that is reopened within the grace period keeps the flow open and emits [pianoanchor.core.model.LinkResumed]; the flow completes normally when the device stays gone. Cancelling the collector closes the device. Fails with [MidiDeviceUnavailableException] if [device] is not listed when collection starts. |

Contract test: `testing/src/commonMain/kotlin/pianoanchor/testing/MidiInputPortContractTest.kt`

## `MidiOutputPort`

Driven port: MIDI messages sent to instruments (e.g. SysEx requests). Contract: `pianoanchor.testing.MidiOutputPortContractTest`.

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `val outputDevices: Flow<List<MidiDevice>>` | Output devices currently available; same emission rules as [MidiInputPort.inputDevices]. |
| `suspend fun send(device: MidiDevice, bytes: ByteArray)` | Sends [bytes] to [device]: one or more complete MIDI messages, delivered in order. Completeness is the caller's job; adapters only check the first byte and forward the bytes unchanged. Suspends until the platform has accepted the bytes. |

Contract test: `testing/src/commonMain/kotlin/pianoanchor/testing/MidiOutputPortContractTest.kt`

## `SettingsRepositoryPort`

Driven port: the learner's [Settings], kept across restarts. Anything never set reads as its default. Throws [StorageUnavailableException] when the store can't be read or written (#55). Contract: `pianoanchor.testing.SettingsRepositoryPortContractTest`.

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `val settings: Flow<Settings>` | The current settings, emitted on collection and again after every [update]. |
| `suspend fun update(change: (Settings) -> Settings)` | Replaces the settings with [change] applied to the current ones. Atomic: concurrent updates apply one after the other, each to the result of the one before, so none is lost. |

Contract test: `testing/src/commonMain/kotlin/pianoanchor/testing/SettingsRepositoryPortContractTest.kt`

## `UpdateCheckPort`

Driven port: the newest published release. One anonymous HTTPS GET; nothing about the learner is sent (`docs/protocols/update-check.md`). The app's only network use, and the learner can turn it off. Contract: `pianoanchor.testing.UpdateCheckPortContractTest`.

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `suspend fun latest(): Release?` | The latest release, or null when it can't be known (offline, error, rate limit). Never throws, except for cancellation. |

Contract test: `testing/src/commonMain/kotlin/pianoanchor/testing/UpdateCheckPortContractTest.kt`
